title: FizzBuzz, but rigorous
prompt: Implement `static string FizzBuzz(int n)` — for 1..n append lines: multiples of 3 → `Fizz`, of 5 → `Buzz`, of both → `FizzBuzz`, else the number. Each line ends with `\n` (including the last). n = 0 returns `""`.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Zero produces nothing; one line still ends with newline.
